description: ¡Bienvenido a Maravilla! Your hidden gem in Rincón — a Boricua-owned casita de playa just a 3-minute walk from Playa Córcega. Created as a place for our own friends and family to relax, reconnect, and enjoy the island, Maravilla is now lovingly shared with guests seeking an authentic Rincón experience. Wake up to Caribbean breezes, beach days, legendary waves, local flavors, and the true rhythm of Puerto Rican island living.The space• A true local Rincón experience. Maravilla was created as a place for our own friends and family — a home designed for slow mornings, meaningful moments, and enjoying the island the way we love to live it. We are proud to share it with guests who want something authentic, personal, and connected to Puerto Rico.• Steps from Playa Córcega. Just a 3-minute walk to a peaceful, swimmable beach, Maravilla is your home base for barefoot beach days, salty afternoons, and unforgettable sunsets. Grab the Tommy Bahama beach chairs, Yeti cooler, beach towels, games, and wagon, and make the beach your backyard.• Designed for island living. Enjoy tropical spaces filled with Caribbean breezes, natural ventilation, and ceiling fans throughout the home. The two bedrooms feature A/C split units, premium Casper king and queen beds, ceiling fans, and quality linens for restful nights after days exploring Rincón.• Eco-conscious comfort. Maravilla combines modern convenience with sustainable island living through solar power with battery backup and water reserve, allowing you to relax, recharge, and enjoy your stay with peace of mind.• A home with Boricua soul. Curated local art, handcrafted touches, cozy corners, and thoughtful details reflect our love for Puerto Rico and create a space that feels connected to the island, our culture, and our people.• Made for gathering. Cook fresh meals in the fully equipped kitchen, enjoy garden views, share cafecito mornings, sunset dinners, and the simple moments that become your favorite memories.• Your private tropical escape. Relax in the lush garden, outdoor lounge, and hammock — the perfect place for morning coffee, afternoon naps, evening drinks, or simply enjoying the Caribbean breeze.• Rincón’s surf and island lifestyle. Explore iconic surf spots like Domes, Sandy Beach, and Tres Palmas just minutes away, along with local restaurants, hidden beaches, and the laid-back west coast culture that makes Rincón unforgettable.• Whether you’re de la isla looking for a weekend reset, part of the Boricua diaspora coming home to reconnect, a surfer chasing waves, or a traveler seeking an authentic Puerto Rican experience — Maravilla welcomes you with warmth, respect, good energy, and true Boricua soul.Guest accessYou have full access to the entire property while respecting the clearly labeled storage areas that are off-limits.Other things to noteArrival & Departure• Check-in: 4:00 PM• Check-out: 11:00 AMWe’re excited to welcome you to Maravilla! Before your stay, we want to share a few important details so you know what to expect and can fully enjoy your time here.A Note About PricingAirbnb recently increased host service fees to nearly 17%. While this change was outside of our control, we’ve had to make small adjustments to continue offering the same Maravilla experience — a thoughtfully cared-for home, quality amenities, and the same love and attention we put into every stay.Returning guests may notice a small change, but what matters most stays the same: the comfort, care, and island feeling that make Maravilla special.We love supporting our local community. Puerto Rico locals, teachers, and first responders are especially appreciated at Maravilla. If this applies to you, please let us know before your stay and provide valid ID or proof of employment. While we’re unable to offer discounts, we truly value what you do and, when our schedule allows, we’ll do our best to accommodate an early check-in or late check-out as a small gesture of appreciation.House GuidelinesMaravilla is our home, and we’re happy to share it with you. We simply ask that everyone who stays here treats it — and each other — with kindness, care, and respect. We welcome guests of all backgrounds, identities, and walks of life.• No smoking or vaping inside the home — $500 fee if violated• No pets — $300 fee plus immediate removal from the property• Maximum of 4 guests total• No parties, events, or subletting• Quiet hours: 10 PM – 8 AM to respect our neighborsTaking Care of MaravillaWe’ve put a lot of love into creating this space, and we appreciate your help keeping it beautiful for everyone who stays after you.• Dark towels are provided for makeup removal only• White towels are for showering only• Please hang wet towels on hooks or racks so they can dry properly• Please do not use towels or linens for cleaning spills, removing makeup, or outdoor activities• Stained or damaged towels/linens may result in a replacement charge ($50 per item)A Few Things About Island Living One of the reasons we love Puerto Rico is because life here is connected to nature. Maravilla is a real island home in a real local neighborhood, which means you may occasionally experience things that are part of everyday island life.UtilitiesPuerto Rico’s utilities can sometimes experience interruptions:• Internet: Liberty PR (no backup available at this time)• Water: AAA service with a 500-gallon backup tank• Power: LUMA service with solar backup and battery storageOur solar system helps provide backup power, but during outages we conserve battery usage. A/C, washer, and dryer may not be available during outages so we can preserve power for essential needs.Island Sounds & WildlifeYou may hear or see some of our local "neighbors":• Coquí frogs singing at night• Roosters in the morning• Neighborhood or stray dogs• Wild iguanas and local catsThese are part of the authentic Puerto Rico experience and are outside of our control. Earplugs & white noise speakers are available for light sleepers.Please do not feed or disturb wildlife — we love and respect the natural environment around us.Hurricane SeasonHurricane season runs June through November, with the highest activity usually in September and October.We recommend travel insurance, especially during hurricane season. Weather events, utility interruptions, wildlife activity, and normal island conditions do not qualify for refunds.Thank you for taking care of Maravilla and respecting our neighbors, as this is a real neighborhood. We hope you enjoy this home as much as we do — slow mornings, ocean breezes, good energy, and all the little moments that make Rincón special.

description: Welcome to Apt Flor del Mar, a chic and stylish second-level apartment in the heart of Rincón, Puerto Rico. Just a 3-minute walk to Black Eagle Beach, you’ll enjoy calm, clear blue waters and easy access to the nearby marina ramp. The apartment’s prime location puts you within walking distance of amazing restaurants, lively bars, and cozy coffee shops, making it the perfect spot for your coastal getaway.The spaceThis recently renovated 3-bedroom apartment is designed to comfortably host up to 10 guests. The main bedroom includes a queen bed and twin bunk beds, while the other two bedrooms each feature a queen bed. The living room sofa converts into a cozy sofa bed for additional sleeping space.Inside, you’ll enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, a spacious living room with a smart TV, and a private terrace with outdoor dining — perfect for family meals or relaxing after a day at the beach. The building is gated for added security, and guests have access to two free parking spots for convenience. A laundry room is also available for use at an additional cost, with rates varying by length of stay.We provide beach essentials such as towels, chairs, an umbrella, and a mini cooler. We kindly ask guests to treat these with care and rinse them off before storing them back in the apartment.Book your stay at Apt Flor del Mar and enjoy the perfect blend of comfort, style, and coastal charm. Whether you’re relaxing on the terrace, exploring Rincon’s vibrant local scene, or soaking up the sun on the beach, this property is designed to make your retreat unforgettable.Guest accessGuests have access to the entire apartment, including the private terrace and living spaces. The apartment building is gated for added security. A laundry room is available on-site for an additional charge.Other things to noteWildlife Note:Please be advised that as our property is located near the beach on a tropical island, it is common to encounter insects and wildlife such as flies, mosquitoes, lizards, ants, and more. The coastal setting and vibrant ecosystem contribute to the area's natural charm. While we take measures to minimize their presence, it’s important to note that insects may be seen both indoors and outdoors.We recommend keeping doors and windows closed whenever possible and properly storing food to avoid attracting unwanted visitors. Please note that we cannot guarantee a wildlife-free environment.Laundry Note:Laundry facilities are available for use at an additional cost due to the island’s high utility expenses. Costs vary depending on the length of your stay.Beach items: We provide some beach items for your stay but not enough to cover a big group. We do include beach towels for each guest.If you are not comfortable with the possibility of encountering the insects and wildlife mentioned above, or if you have questions about laundry use, we encourage you to consider if our property aligns with your preferences. We value transparency and want to ensure your stay meets your expectations. Should you have any concerns or need assistance, please don’t hesitate to contact us.

description: Casa Coquí is an ocean-view home offering stunning vistas of both the ocean and mountains. Enjoy sunrises and sunsets from our three balconies. Relax in a private heated pool, play billiards, or explore world-class surfing, paddle boarding, kayaking, fishing, and scuba diving spots, all within walking distance. Located in a family-friendly neighborhood, Casa Coquí is close to a playground, ball field, and pizzeria. Centrally located, it provides easy access to all that Rincon has to offer.The spaceWelcome to Casa Coquì, a stunning three-story sanctuary boasting luxury amenities and breathtaking views. On the first floor, dive into relaxation with an inviting in-ground heated pool, complete with underwater benches and shelves for ultimate comfort. Bask in the sun on the outdoor deck, furnished with plush seating and an expansive dining table for al fresco meals under the stars. Entertainment awaits with a billiards table and cornhole game, while the outdoor BBQ and beverage coolers make hosting a breeze. Indulge in the beauty of the brand-new bathroom featuring an outdoor shower, all while staying cool under the two ceiling fans. Ascend the spiral staircase to the living quarters, where the second floor offers a dedicated office space and three bedrooms, each equipped with split air conditioners and ceiling fans for personalized comfort. Luxuriate in the master bath's jacuzzi tub before gathering in the fully-equipped kitchen and dining area, or unwind in the living room with a smart TV and cable subscription. Step onto the two outdoor decks to soak in the surrounding beauty, with one off the living room and another off the master bedroom. The third floor promises panoramic ocean and mountain views from a private deck, where a cozy living room with ocean vistas and a smart TV awaits. Retreat to the bedroom, cooled by a split air conditioner and ceiling fan, before ending the day in style with outdoor furnishings and fans on the wrap-around deck. Escape to Casa Coquì for an unforgettable getaway.Guest accessYou will either need a vehicle or taxi to get around. There is no Uber or lift service in the Rincon area. Guest parking is located outside of the gate on the street.Other things to notePool is heated with both a solar and propane system. The solar system typically keeps the pool around 85/86*. If you would like the pool to be heated warmer we can use the propane system but there will be an additional charge of $60 per day. Heater will be running for 12 hours per day with pool pump system.
